riley: Heads-up 1: small billing anomalies tied to background embed toolcalls + stream reconnects. Looks like parent stream + child embed both got billed.

noah: Trace?

riley: trc_22f3. Short flow: client opens stream -> runtime fires async embed toolcall -> toolcall TTL truncates mid-output -> client reconnects and resumes stream on a different model-worker -> ledger shows provisional credits for both sessions and both later confirmed.

anu: Likely session headers not propagated into the async embed. Workers spawn child calls without X-RW-Session, so ledger treats them as separate sessions.

noah: Quick fixes: 1) router should forward X-RW-Session/X-RW-Seq into internal toolcalls, 2) child toolcalls should include parent-session and token-window metadata, 3) provisional credits stay reversible until checkpoint/EOF.

riley: Sketch of minimal header+checkpoint:

X-RW-Session: rw-s-22
X-RW-Seq: 88
X-RW-Parent: rw-s-21

POST /checkpoint { session: "rw-s-22", seq: 88, confirmed_tokens: 64 }

anu: Ops/UI: add provisional vs confirmed columns in request details + a "dry-reconcile" action that shows proposed token deltas for a session without applying them. Operator can accept to mutate ledger.

noah: Telemetry: session_finalization_lag, provisional_to_confirm_ratio, child_overlap_count histogram. Alert if >5% sessions in a minute have finalization_lag > 30s for canary traffic.

riley: deploy-bot: router change to forward session headers to internal calls deployed to canary 5%.

anu: I'll draft a short RFC: header spec, checkpoint endpoint, ledger dry_run API, and console reconcile flow. Assign to billing + infra. Meeting tomorrow 11am.

noah: Also make runtime embed helper that propagates parent headers by default to avoid missing metadata.

riley: Filing: https://git.redwood/repo/issue/912 (draft). Thanks.
